تستجنسن (form X)

# تُسْتَجْنَسْنَ (tustajnasna) /tus.tad͡ʒ.nas.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
